result.topic_en: Notes, partly in Latin and partly in German, on the composition of binary quadratic forms with negative determinant. They are accompanied by square-root expressions in variables x, y, z, t and ξ, η, ζ labelled by combinations of characteristics 0, a, b, c, ∂. Graph-like diagrams of numbered boxes and circles appear alongside index tables such as 34√12 and 1√3456.
